lines: Lyra: The hearts are free, and the archived hours belong to their keepers. This is the page we write afterward.
Mara’s measurements can still be brought home; freedom is not the same as finished repair.
Tovan’s hearth is still waiting for Summer Coal.
The Charter is not yet published. That work remains ours to choose.
Orin’s signed testimony is still there to read.
The king has a tomorrow. His orders stay in the public record.
Lyra: No new crown. No perfect tomorrow. Just people who can choose what comes next.
